title: Tom's Favourite Sport
text:
Tom likes sport very much. On Saturdays he plays football with his friends in the park. He wears his blue shirt and his new shoes.

After the game, Tom is always tired but happy. His mum brings water and fruit for everyone. Tom says football is his favourite hobby.

questions.text: What does Tom's mum bring after the game?
How does Tom probably feel about football?
What is most likely true about Tom's friends?
options: They never go to the park.

vocabulary.definition: a public green area where people can walk and play
the one that you like most
having no energy after working or playing

paragraph_translations: Tom bardzo lubi sport. W soboty gra w piłkę nożną ze swoimi kolegami w parku. Ma na sobie niebieską koszulkę i nowe buty.
Po meczu Tom jest zawsze zmęczony, ale szczęśliwy. Jego mama przynosi wodę i owoce dla wszystkich. Tom mówi, że piłka nożna to jego ulubione hobby.
